runner: run_vla_adapter_libero.py: VLA-Adapter experiments/robot/libero/run_libero_eval.py (GenerateConfig, initialize_model, prepare_observation, process_action) and its run_episode loop
env_seed: env.seed(0) in get_libero_env; global seed 7 set once
max_steps: episode_lengths per suite if set, else --env.episode_length in the extra flags if set, else LeRobot defaults (spatial 280, object 280, goal 300, libero_10 520)
note: Official VLA-Adapter LIBERO settings: Qwen2.5-0.5B mini-VLM, 2 images + proprio, L1-regression policy, chunks of 8 actions open-loop, center crop, 256 px env images, 10 no-op steps, max steps 220/280/300/520, unnorm_key <suite>_no_noops, seed 7; use_pro_version=False and save_version=vla-adapter for the original (non-Pro) checkpoints, whose shipped eval logs show 97.8 (spatial) and 95.0 (long). Env envs/vla-adapter (venv on roboelo-univla: transformers 4.40.1, torch 2.7.1+cu128 instead of the pinned 2.2.0, MuJoCo 3.3.2). An exception is recorded and the rollout re-run (the official loop counts it as a failure).
policy_settings: as stored in the checkpoint (policy_config.json) unless overridden by the extra flags
